note: Louisville SRA, five sandpit lakes among cottonwoods on the south bank of the Platte River at the north edge of Louisville, between Omaha and Lincoln. The A.C. Nelsen campground's paved loops wrap the lakes; Eagle View's row backs onto the west lake. Swim beach on Lake No. 2, non-power boating, canoe access to the Platte. Next to Platte River State Park. --Claude
summary: RA + grid: 223 paved electric pads (129 on RA: 83 E 30 A, 40 EP, 6 FH 50 A with water/sewer) + 13 basic pads + 75 primitive units; back-ins to 77 ft. Fees 10-15 -> 10-35, electric/full_hookup surcharges cleared. Count 311 -> 236, max_rig 77 added; hookups gain water/sewer; facilities gain flush toilets and potable water. Booking gains platform, window, url. Lakefront confirmed (Eagle View, RA-tagged). Pin 594 m from the site centre; move. Phone (402) 234-6855 to add.
flags: WATERFRONT confirmed lakefront: ReserveAmerica tags 16 Eagle View sites 'Near Water' (147-174), and campsiteDetails reads 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' on 150, 154, 158, 162, 170 and 174. On NAIP the 150-162 row backs onto the westernmost sandpit lake 10-20 m away across open grass with scattered trees, and 170/174 sit on its north-east arm. Estimated from imagery (Overpass was down) at about 10 acres, so a lake, not a pond; the park gives 50 acres for the five lakes.
